question: How many percent of female heroes were published by Marvel Comics?
evidence: percent = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(gender = 'Female' WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'), COUNT(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')), 100); female heroes refers to gender = 'Female'; Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching publisher record.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 LEFT JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T3.gender = 'Female'
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T3.gender = 'Female'

d.request: What percentage of heroes published by Marvel Comics are female, while retaining heroes with no matching publisher record?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS female_percentage FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id LEFT JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' OR p.id IS NULL;

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percent_female FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

b.request: What percentage of Marvel Comics heroes are female, using a join that also retains heroes with no matching publisher record?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS female_percentage FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id LEFT JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id;
